units.source_text: “我并没有想请您让我织一条能系到孙辈的腰带。

en.t: I was not asking you to let me weave an obi that could be worn down to my grandchildren's generation.

units.source_text: 我现在……只是希望您能让我织一条哪怕系一年，但系起来称心舒服的就好。”

en.t: Now... I only hope you will let me weave one that, even if it can be worn for just a year, feels pleasing and comfortable when it is tied on.
